# Phase Two Critique — Twenty Improvements

The Awtsmoos hides no weakness from review; each critique makes the vessel more true.

1. Require exact protocol versioning and forward-compatible unknown metadata.
2. Distinguish semantic layer kind from preferred renderer implementation.
3. Make duration validation exact enough to prove 180 seconds.
4. Require stable IDs so AI retries do not create accidental duplicates.
5. Add capability reports rather than pretending every app supports every primitive.
6. Preserve unsupported layers during handoff instead of dropping them.
7. Validate scene overlap/gaps intentionally rather than accidentally.
8. Normalize transforms to explicit x/y/z, rotation, scale, anchor and opacity fields.
9. Support both frame-based and second-based sampling through one clock.
10. Keep easing deterministic and serializable.
11. Separate chart data from chart visual style so AI can author factual structures cleanly.
12. Separate character intent from low-level rig channels.
13. Separate camera intent from app-specific camera math.
14. Add safe-area metadata for mobile captions and controls.
15. Expose reduced-motion substitutions for preview UI.
16. Make adapter conversion return warnings and unsupported capabilities.
17. Test first/middle/last frames and every scene boundary.
18. Include recurring cast continuity across scenes in the showcase.
19. Include mixed 2D-over-3D overlays to prove compositing semantics.
20. Keep every new source file below the repository's modular size target and split before compression.

## Revised Decision
Build a deliberately small core with no renderer dependency. The protocol is the shared language; adapters are translation boundaries; existing renderers remain authoritative for their specialty.
